senses.gloss:
आघुष् €1 P.
—1 To proclaim, cry aloud, declare.
—2 To praise.
—3 To listen.
—4 To make oneself audible; आस्यश्रवस्याद् रथ आ च घोषात् Rv. 5. 37. 3.
[]
 €10 P. or Caus.
—1 To make a noise, to cause to sound.
—2 To proclaim, announce publicly.
—3 To complain continually, weep bitterly.

आघूर्ण् €1 Ā., €6 P.
—1 To roll, stagger, whirl, toss about; आघूर्णतीवानिलैः
 (अम्बरम्) Mk. 5. 27; पवनाघूर्णितपादप Hariv.; Bk. 14. 77.
—2 To swim, roll (as eyes); पुष्पासवाधूर्णितनेत्रशोभि Ku. 3. 38.
आघूर्णनम् Rolling, tossing about, whirling round, swimming.
